{{Quote|Sometimes they even don water tanks and join the air-breathers inside for brief periods&hellip;they're a very friendly people.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 74">[[Star Wars (1977) 74|''Star Wars'' (1977) 74]]</ref>}}
[[File:Kiro3.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Kiro wearing a water tank on the surface of Iskalon.]]
A '''water tank''' was the name given to a special suit worn by [[Iskalonian]]s when they left the oceans of [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]]. The more modern suits were simply a helmet that was able to circulate water. Older suits covered the whole body and had lots of padding to prevent the suit from being damaged. During his [[Skirmish on Kinooine|mission to Kinooine]], [[Kiro]] was able to create a makeshift water tank by combining a flight helmet with a portable water tank, which indicated that these were not the most complicated machines.
